issues.text: You stopped paying your E M I. In ninety-one days, the bank marks you a defaulter. No court needed... the bank can come for your home. And the scariest part? A paper you signed... on day one.
issues.heard: you stop paying your emi in 91 days the bank marks you a defaulter no court needed the bank can come for your home and the scariest part a paper you signed on day one

issues.text: This is K R's What If Explained. I went through fourteen R B I rules, laws and Supreme Court judgments for this. Say you took a home loan of thirty lakh rupees. Your E M I is about twenty-six thousand a month.
issues.heard: this is kr is what if exclaimed i went through 14 rbi i rules laws and supreme court judgments for this say you took a home loan of 30 lakh rupees your emi is about 26000 a month

issues.text: Day one. Midnight. You're asleep. The auto-debit knocks on your account... and finds it empty. That same night, the bank's computer marks you overdue. Not a manager. A computer. You wake up to two S M S.
issues.heard: day one midnight you are asleep the auto debit knocks on your account and finds it empty that same night the bank is computer marks you overdue not a manager a computer you wake up to 2 sms

issues.text: One: E M I bounced. Two: a five hundred rupee fine for that failed debit, plus G S T. That's the bounce charge, at a big bank like H D F C.
issues.heard: one emi bounced 2 a 500 rupee fine for that failed debit plus gst that is the bounce charge at a big bank like hdfc

issues.text: Your first fear: now they'll pile interest on top of this fine too. They can't. Since twenty twenty-four, R B I says: a flat penal charge. No interest on top of it.
issues.heard: your 1st fear now they have piled interest on top of this fine too they can not since 2024 rb i says a flat penal charge no interest on top of it

issues.text: Day thirty. You're at your desk when your phone lights up. Unknown number. You don't pick up. It rings again. And again. In movies, this is where goons kick down your door. In real life, R B I has rules.
issues.heard: day 30 you are at your desk when your phone lights up unknown number you do not pick up it rings again and again in movies this is where goons kick down your door in real life rb i has rules

issues.text: Day thirty-one. You've missed a full E M I, and your loan gets a label. S M A one. Special Mention Account. Every two weeks, lenders send updates to credit bureaus like CIBIL. So now your report shows it.
issues.heard: day 31 you missed a full emi and your loan gets a label sm a one special mention account every 2 weeks lenders send updates to credit bureaus like su so now your report shows it

issues.text: Quick pause. If this is your life right now... breathe. Almost everything you'll see next can still be stopped. Especially if you act early.
issues.heard: quick pause if this is your life right now breathe almost everything you will see next can still be stopped especially if you act early

issues.text: Your name. Your address. Printed in two newspapers... one in your own language.
issues.heard: your name your address printed in 2 newspapers one in your own language

issues.text: But on day one, you signed an auto-debit mandate. And when that bounces... the law treats it like a bounced cheque. It can mean up to two years in jail. Rare. But real.
issues.heard: but on day one you signed an auto debit mandate and when that bounces the law treats it like a bounce check it can mean up to 2 years in jail rare but real

issues.text: One bounced E M I is a bad month. Not a bad life. So next time the phone buzzes... you call them first. Ever got that bounce S M S? Yes or no? Next time: what if India and Pakistan never split?

issues.text: Day one. That same night, the bank's computer marks you overdue. Day thirty. The calls start. But by R B I rules... never before eight in the morning. Never after seven at night.
